item.title: Robbery investigation leads to SWAT response in South Augusta
item.description: A robbery reported Saturday afternoon led to a large law enforcement presence in south Augusta, according to Chief of Staff Lewis Blanchard with the Richmond County Sheriff’s Office. item.title: Senate bill would hold down property tax increases that fund Georgia schools
item.description: Tax increases on Georgia homeowners could be limited to the inflation rate — including taxes for education after most school systems decided against capping property tax hikes last year. The post Senate bill would hold down property tax increases that fund Georgia schools appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: SRNS, Enercon complete design review for training center tied to plutonium facility
item.description: Savannah River Nuclear Solutions (SRNS) and subcontractor Enercon completed the Formal Design Review in December for the High-Fidelity Training and Operations Center, a subproject supporting the Savannah River Plutonium Processing Facility. The post SRNS, Enercon complete design review for training center tied to plutonium facility appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Tri-college MLK celebration brings Augusta leaders and students together at Paine College
item.description: Augusta’s higher education leaders, students, and community members gathered Friday at Paine College’s Gilbert-Lambuth Memorial Chapel for the annual Tri-College Martin Luther King Jr. celebration, honoring Dr. King’s enduring legacy of service, unity, and nonviolent leadership. The post Tri-college MLK celebration brings Augusta leaders and students together at Paine College appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Community vigorously opposes data center development in lengthy Planning Commission hearing
item.description: The Columbia County Planning Commission meeting which commissioners voted to recommend approval for three rezoning requests making way for data center lasted for nearly five hours. item.title: Two wanted after Augusta victim lured from ATM in Saturday robbery
item.description: Two suspects wanted in a Saturday armed robbery are believed to have slipped away as a SWAT team was responding to a home connected to the case, according to investigators. item.title: Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter
item.description: A Hephzibah mother of five who was caught on video beating and screaming at her 9-year-old daughter has been charged with child cruelty, authorities said. The post Hephzibah mom caught on video abusing 9-year-old daughter appeared first on The Augusta Press.
